provenance.note: L0 baseline before any optimisation. Plugin APK built from the 939ed73 source tree with VERSION_BUILD=91 still in version.properties; host 6.8.0/5328 built from 2467c3eb03. Fixture revision without the first-statement stamp file; S3 warm-up run excluded.

L0-6 release cold-start race check: 15 additional S1 runs (20 in total with the baseline record), every run emitted with no compiler error; supervisor registration completed at about 949 ms process uptime, right after the 904 ms onCreate that currently masks the race. Stopwatch stamps unavailable in this batch (fixture still wrote the stamp relative to the host working directory).

L0-7 stopwatch cross-check with the committed fixture revision (closure-based accumulator, absolute STAMP_PATH injected by the script). stopwatchMs is the device wall-clock difference between the launch request and the fixture's first statement; it exceeds userWaitMs by about 330 ms of launch dispatch and script start-up, well inside the 10 percent acceptance band.

After plugin L1-1..L1-4 (process-level declaration cache, background declaration preload, WebView primed at boot, bounded supervisor wait); host still the L0 schema-3 build without discovery caching. Plugin APK built from the 70b3d69 source tree with VERSION_BUILD=93 in version.properties.

After plugin L1-1..L1-4 plus host L1-5 (discovery cache keyed by package identity). discoveryMs collapses to 2-3 ms in every scenario; on S1 the compiler process start therefore moves from discovery into bindPrewarmMs, so the cold total is unchanged while S2/S3 drop by the discovery cost. First S1 sample is an outlier (host process was freshly reinstalled).

Plugin L2-1 (preloaded declaration layers, PRELOADED transport; APK built from the db3429c tree before VERSION_BUILD moved 95 -> 96, code identical) with the pre-fix host. S1 compilerIngressMs collapses 2924 -> 129 ms but S2 regresses to 4.8 s: the long-lived host process kept a stale warm binding that still reported isBinderAlive, so every compilation closed its own dedicated binding, the plugin service was destroyed after each job and the resident realm was lost (bindPrewarmMs 1436, compilerParseMs 1599 on S2). Kept as evidence for roadmap L3-1 / L3-4; superseded by 20261009-l2-api35-23046rp50c-preload.
